text_block_list.text:
In order to secure a base, we must win the 
crucial race: the Challenge Cup.

The day before that race— I arrived at the 
candidate site, a five-minute walk from 
Tracen Academy, with all my friends.
(Whooooosh......)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "This is... This is truly the place..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Our... promised land.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, real estate uncle. If Tap wins 
tomorrow, will you really...

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'll rent it to you for cheap. Just as 
promised!

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to build a simple prefab, 
right? Then once we haul in the materials, 
we can put it up in no time.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"It's really... being built... Our very 
own hangout spot..."

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
Then that means we can get together 
whenever we want. We won't have to worry 
about saying goodbye someday.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Of course! ...It'll be built, you bet 
it'll be built! Right, Trainer!?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I've devoted everything for that 
very reason.

Yeah, because I've dedicated everything 
for this.

text_block_list.text:
Every victory, every effort was made to 
secure this place. That was—

"It's not about empty ideals like 
prestige. It's simply so I won't be torn 
apart from the friends I love."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't panic, everyone. Don't rush in 
greedily. Not yet, not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's not built yet! WOOOOOAAAAAHHH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Tap?! You're the one who needs to calm 
down, Tap?!

In the end, her excitement never cooled 
down, and the big day arrived—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer... How do I put it, I...! I am...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH!!

This is way beyond Gâ ¢ excitement. Could 
anyone be this fired up even for an 
international Gâ ?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list:
As long as I don't lose my composure, I 
can win this.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Composure. Stay calm...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I am totally calm!! Just watch me, 
everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH!!

"Today of all days, there's no calming 
this fired-up excitement. Even so..."

Let's put our faith in Tap Dance City 
here. The curtain rises on a GIII race we 
cannot afford to lose under any 
circumstances.
